A '''translator droid''' was owned by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Tresk Im'nel]]. Before Im'nel owned the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], it had another owner. Im'nel used the [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]] during his time as a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]], and later during his time as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. The droid was owned by Im'nel from the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] formation to the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TIBN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tresk Imnel's translator droid was briefly mentioned in "Tresk Im'nel, Bothan Noble," a [[2002]] article written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and posted on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s website for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TIBN" />
